# Fetch all playlists in library (paginate)
playlist_ids=[]

    print('playlist_library page', page_index, 'returned', len(page))

    page_index += 1
print('total playlist_ids', len(playlist_ids))
print('playlist_ids', playlist_ids)

# Fetch each playlist details and collect song ids with mapping
song_to_playlists=collections.defaultdict(set)
playlist_song_info=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    title=pl.get('title')
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    print('playlist', pid, title, 'songs', len(songs))
    for s in songs:
        sid=s['id']
        song_to_playlists[sid].add(pid)
        playlist_song_info.append((pid,title,sid,s.get('title'), [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists',[])]))

unique_song_ids=list(song_to_playlists.keys())
print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# For each song, fetch details to get genre + artists
song_genres=collections.Counter()
reggae_songs=[]
song_artist_map={}
for idx,sid in enumerate(unique_song_ids):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=(sd.get('genre') or '').strip()
    g_norm=genre.lower()
    song_genres[g_norm]+=1
    artists=sd.get('artists',[])
    artist_ids=[a.get('id') for a in artists]
    artist_names=[a.get('name') for a in artists]
    song_artist_map[sid]={'artist_ids':artist_ids,'artist_names':artist_names,'genre':genre,'title':sd.get('title')}
    if 'reggae' in g_norm:
        reggae_songs.append(sid)

print('top genres (norm)')

    print(g,c)
print('reggae_songs count (genre contains reggae)', len(reggae_songs))

# Build target artist ids from reggae songs
target_artist_ids=set()
reggae_song_rows=[]
for sid in reggae_songs:
    info=song_artist_map[sid]
    target_artist_ids.update(info['artist_ids'])
    reggae_song_rows.append({
        'song_title': info['title'],
        'genre': info['genre'],
        'artists': ', '.join(info['artist_names']),
        'playlists_count': len(song_to_playlists[sid])
    })

print('target_artist_ids count', len(target_artist_ids))
print('sample reggae_song_rows (up to 5)')
for row in reggae_song_rows[:5]:
    print(row)

# Print full target artist ids
print('target_artist_ids', sorted(list(target_artist_ids))[:50], '... total', len(target_artist_ids))

import collections

# Login
spotify_pwd=None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name']=='spotify':
        spotify_pwd=a['password']
access_token=apis.spotify.login(username='andrew_brow@gmail.com', password=spotify_pwd)['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists in library (paginate fully)
playlist_ids=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    playlist_ids += [pl['playlist_id'] for pl in page]
    page_index += 1

# Collect songs from playlists
song_ids=set()
playlist_song_map=collections.defaultdict(set)  # pid -> song ids
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    for s in pl.get('songs',[]):
        song_ids.add(s['id'])
        playlist_song_map[pid].add(s['id'])

# Determine reggae songs and build artist->source songs mapping
reggae_song_rows=[]  # list dict
artist_to_reggae_sources=collections.defaultdict(list)  # artist_id -> list of (song_id,title)

for sid in sorted(song_ids):
    sd=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=(sd.get('genre') or '').strip().lower()
    if 'reggae' in genre:
        title=sd.get('title')
        for art in sd.get('artists',[]):
            aid=art.get('id')
            if aid is None: continue
            artist_to_reggae_sources[aid].append({'song_id':sid,'song_title':title})
        reggae_song_rows.append({'song_id':sid,'song_title':title,'genre':sd.get('genre') or '',
                                  'artists':[a.get('name') for a in sd.get('artists',[]) if a.get('name') is not None]})

# Current following artists
following_artist_ids=set()
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    for a in page:
        following_artist_ids.add(a['artist_id'])
    page_index += 1

# Prepare verification table for artists
verification_artists=[]
need_ids=[]
already_ids=[]
for aid, sources in sorted(artist_to_reggae_sources.items(), key=lambda x: x[0]):
    art=apis.spotify.show_artist(artist_id=aid)
    name=art.get('name')
    if aid in following_artist_ids:
        already_ids.append(aid)
    else:
        need_ids.append(aid)
    verification_artists.append({'artist_id':aid,'artist_name':name,'artist_genre':art.get('genre'),
                                  'reggae_songs':', '.join(sorted({s['song_title'] for s in sources}))})

print('Reggae song count:', len(reggae_song_rows))
print('Target artist count (unique artists from reggae songs):', len(verification_artists))
print('Already following (should be empty if none):', sorted(already_ids))
print('Need to follow:', sorted(need_ids))
print('\nSample reggae song rows (up to 10):')
for row in reggae_song_rows[:10]:
    print(row)
print('\nVerification artists table:')
for row in verification_artists:
    print(row)
